scores.rationale: The candidate is an incomplete mid-flight implementation (as shown by its own `.lore/dod.md`, which is also committed to the repo). In `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts`, it imports `Ajv` as a default export and uses Ajv v6 APIs (`new Ajv({format: false})`, `e.dataPath`) despite installing Ajv v8 (`8.20.0`), which uses `instancePath` and `validateFormats: false`, causing typecheck/build failures and broken field path reporting (`e.dataPath` is undefined, falling back to `'/'` and failing its own test). Furthermore, dynamic function-valued `ToolDefinitionSource` schemas are compiled once at registration time rather than resolved and WeakMap-cached per `execute` call. Most of the acceptance criteria are completely missing, including the required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, the doc comment on `execute`, and the updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`.
